CreateAsyncTranslate.description_en: The machine asynchronous translation job creation API supports translation of up to 1 million characters.

CreateImageTranslateTask.description_en: Create an asynchronous image translation job. Image translation includes capabilities such as OCR, text translation, and text backfill
CreateImageTranslateTask.description_zh: 创建异步图片翻译，图片翻译包含文字识别、文本翻译、文字回填等能力

GetAsyncTranslate.description_en: Retrieve the content of an asynchronous text translation job
GetAsyncTranslate.description_zh: 获取文本异步翻译任务内容

GetBatchTranslate.description_zh: 机器批量翻译，支持多段文本进行翻译

GetDetectLanguage.description_en: This document describes the language detection API

GetImageDiagnose.description_zh: 能够识别图片中的文字的语种

GetImageTranslate.description_en: Includes capabilities such as OCR, text translation, and text backfill.
GetImageTranslate.description_zh: 包含文字识别、文本翻译、文字回填等能力

GetTitleDiagnose.description_zh: 通过商品标题质量诊断服务，产出可视化的标题质量分，便于卖家对现有的商品标题质量有实际体感

GetTitleGenerate.description_zh: 基于电商大数据，自动优化商品标题

GetTitleIntelligence.description_zh: 通过类目、平台、关键词，自动生成商品标题

GetTranslateReport.description_en: Obtain the API call report based on the API name and the start and end times, and return the results aggregated by day or hour according to the specified group parameter
